items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: I made arrangements for Charlie Strait.

ctx.x: Or was it, 25? I was still in the 20s there.
Still in the 20s. I made arrangements for Charlie Strait.
He was active later, but I think his good band was in mid 20s. Yeah, in mid 20s.
